newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan investigators recover T$900 mln after fraud.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan investigators recover T$900 mln after fraud.

text.p: Taiwan's investigation authorities have recovered about T$900 million out of the T$1.05 billion in banknotes lost by two local securities brokerages in a recent fraud scandal, local media reported on Wednesday.
"Investigation and police authorities are still working on recovering the rest of the money," the mass-circulation China Times Express quoted unnamed investigation sources as saying.
Fraudsters this week used fake certificates of deposit to withdraw T$1.05 billion from Taiwan Securities Investment Trust and Chronicle Securities Investment Trust.
Police have arrested five people. The securities firms have said they could easily cover the losses even if the rest of the money could not be recovered.
